nodes.title: director15 c6 stuck row 18 ("picture dikhao" over the remediation's lettered hexagon; the record re-drew the then-card's pentagon) was replayed through Brain's planTurn (tests/fixtures/replay.mjs, the run's recorded reads, no model calls). Production gets it right. Row 16 reaches Studio's seam as scriptBeat.kind "remediation", and row 18's preselect offers "unrolled": the hexagon laid straight (unrolled@1), then the pentagon. The miss is the eval harness's model of the seam. Its tree (2e9664b34, and int/r6 719104f57) never got patch 017's shownKind, so it passed the preselect no avoidKind. Its bookkeeping on the same replay gives the card's measured@1, the run's row; with the page-up kind it gives unrolled. Brain's patch 018 (docs/patches/to-brain) adds shownKind and avoidKind to the current harness; 017 no longer applies, and its S9 half is already in Brain's P4. Pinned: tests/r8-director15.test.mjs.
